title: Visual Recipe Edit-Create
description: Visual Recipe Edit-Create is a Create add-on that provides a visual GUI for creating new recipes and editing or disabling certain existing Create recipes. Recipe changes take effect after leaving and re-entering the world.
body:
Introduction
Visual Recipe Edit-Create is a Create add-on that provides a visual GUI for creating new recipes and editing or disabling certain existing Create recipes. Recipe changes take effect after leaving and re-entering the world.

Detailed Description
Use /vre create gui to open the main screen and browse all 14 recipe types: Pressing, Mixing, Crushing, Cutting, Milling, Compacting, Sandpaper Polishing, Splashing, Haunting, Deploying, Filling, Emptying, Mechanical Crafting, and Sequenced Assembly. Click any type to enter its dedicated editing page, which offers fields for item inputs, fluid inputs, output items with probabilities, processing time, and heat requirements, along with convenient item/fluid pickers and a tag picker.

In the Recipe Management screen (/vre create manage), you can search all registered Create recipes and click “Edit” to modify those that are editable. You can also add any recipe to a blacklist to temporarily disable it, and restore blacklisted recipes.

All created or modified recipes are saved as JSON files in the config/visual_recipe_edit_create/ directory.

The mod fully supports both Chinese and English, with the UI language automatically following the game setting.

Commands
/vre create gui – Opens the recipe type selection screen to create new recipes.
/vre create manage – Opens the recipe management screen to edit, disable, or restore existing recipes.

Note
This is a Create add-on; please use it with Create 6.0.8 or later.

Not all vanilla Create recipes support visual editing: pure Create processing recipes (e.g., those under “Mixed Mixing”) can be fully edited, while “Auto‑Stirring” and “Auto‑Brewing” recipes that inherit from crafting/brewing systems do not have dedicated editing pages (you can still disable them in the management screen).

Recipe changes only take effect after leaving and re-entering the current world.
